The Hybrid Manager (HM) operator is released independently of Hybrid Manager itself. These release notes describe what changed in each operator release.

A single `2.x` operator supports a range of HM versions. To find the operator version that goes with the HM release you are running or upgrading to, see the [compatibility matrix](../compatibility_matrix).


| Version | Release date |
|---|---|
| [2.0.0](./hm-operator_2.0.0_rel_notes) | 04 Jun 2026 |
!!! Note Releases before 2.0.0
    Before 2.0.0 the operator was versioned and released together with Hybrid Manager. Changes to those earlier versions are described in the [Hybrid Manager release notes](/edb-postgres-ai/current/hybrid-manager/release_notes/).
